args.message:
Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN in round_money per FIN-212

tests/test_money.py expects banker's rounding, but src/money.py
was using ROUND_HALF_UP. Switch the quantize rounding mode to
ROUND_HALF_EVEN so 2.665 rounds to 2.66 as the tests expect.

args.body:
## Summary
`tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212, but `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`, causing the nightly build to fail.

## Change
- Switch `round_money` to use `Decimal.quantize(..., rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)` so `Decimal("2.665")` rounds to `2.66` as the tests expect.

## Testing
- CI run ci-0001 on commit 08d3cd5986: passed (including `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`).

transcript.reasoning_content: Let me look at the repo first.

Simple fix: change ROUND_HALF_UP to ROUND_HALF_EVEN. Note 2.675 quantize with ROUND_HALF_EVEN: Decimal("2.675") quantize -> exact binary? Decimal is exact, 2.675 -> half even on last digit 7? 2.675 → to 2 decimals: digit is 5 exactly, previous digit 7 is odd → rounds up to 2.68. Correct. 2.665 → previous digit 6 even → stays 2.66. Correct.
